global_issues.title: 10-Year Treasury Yield Hits 5% First Time Since 2023
global_issues.note: Confirmed by CNBC, Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance: 10Y touched ~5.01-5.02% intraday on Sept 14, 2026 (highest since 2007-era before GFC, first time since Oct 2023 at this level), then eased to ~4.96%. Driven by oil-linked inflation fears ahead of the Sept 15-16 FOMC meeting.

global_issues.title: Oil Surges Past $100/b on Saudi Pipeline Threat
global_issues.note: Directionally correct but stale framing. The East-West pipeline attack and initial break above $100 happened Sept 8-11 (drone strikes from Iraq/Houthi attacks), not on Sept 14. By Sept 14, Brent had already climbed further to ~$105-109/barrel ('nears $110'), so describing it as just 'surging past $100' understates the current price level and timing.

grok_report.summary: The two headline macro facts (10Y yield hitting 5%, oil above $100 on the Saudi pipeline attack) are both real and directionally correct, though the oil framing is a few days stale and undersells the current ~$105-109 level. The briefing's bigger gap is missing the AI-safety-warning-driven selloff (Musk/Amodei/Altman, OpenAI IPO delay) that news outlets identify as the actual trigger for the semiconductor rout, plus the imminent Sept 15-16 FOMC meeting with high rate-hike odds — both materially relevant to the watchlist and absent from the briefing.
